svg.title: Solver and non-solver time of the fastest tuples
svg.desc: Stacked horizontal bars of median solver time and remaining application wall time, in seconds, for the fastest solver tuple of the OpenMP, MPI, and hybrid builds in every suite, labelled with both parts. The remainder includes start-up, forcing input from the shared file system, and output. Computational diagnostic; no confidence intervals.
